reader_summary.headline: My guest today is David Fialkow, co-founder of General Catalyst.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is David Fialkow, co-founder of General Catalyst. If you are looking for a dose of fun, charismatic energy from a very unique investor then this is the conversation for you. David has a diverse background not only as an investor but also as a philanthropist and filmmaker.

key_points.text: He won an Academy Award for his role as the producer of the 2018 documentary Icarus.
During our conversation, David and I dive into what makes a great founder, the importance of storytelling.
After listening to all of his great stories, I think you’ll see why David has so much fun and success helping founders.
